To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the equation of state of a perfect single-grained AlPdMnP quasicrystal is accurately determined from angle-dispersive x-ray diffraction data up to 35GPa.

(1) the equation of state of a perfect single-grained quasicrystal is accurately determined to be V0 = 2.07 Å3, Kt0 = 1.7(2) and Kt' = -0.0005(1) and (2) the frozen-in phasonic strain does not change under pressure.
the equation of state of a quasicrystal is determined with unprecedented accuracy and that the phason strain is not affected by hydrostatic pressure.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of pressure on the frozen-in structural strain in AlPdMni quasicrystals.
the study of the pressure-induced amorphous-to-crystalline phase transitions in the AlPdMns system.
the effect of pressure on the structure of the AlPdMns single-grain quasicrystal, and the pressure-induced amorphous state.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the quasicrystal structure remains stable up to 35 GPa and the frozen-in phasonic strain is pressure insensitive in the range studied.
AlPdMns are not pressure-induced amorphous, but are pressure-induced phason defects, and the phason strain is frozen in at ambient pressure.
the quasicrystal is not amorphized by pressure, and its phason structure is not affected by pressure, at least up to 35 GPa.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
AlPdMnin the pressure range of 0–35 GPa remains in the perfect icosahedral structure with the frozen-in phasons and no detectable amorphization.
the equation of state for AlPdMnin the 0-35 GPa pressure range is well reproduced by a third-order Birch-Murnaghan equation with K0 = 70.2(1)GPa and K0' = 4.2(1).

the equation of state of the AlPdMns quasicrystal is similar to that of a perfect single crystal of a conventional crystal, with the exception of a small but significant difference in the pressure dependence of the 6D volume.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, at least up to 35GPa, the quasicrystal remains a stable, well-defined phase with a frozen-in strain that is pressure dependent.
AlPdMns is a robust material with a high-pressure limit of at least 35 GPa that is likely much higher.
